metadata.notes: === MANUAL ACTION REQUIRED === After import: (1) Rebind Airtable connection on modules 1, 2, 3, 6 to SSS PAT. Module 1: Requests (tblTlSB9CO4dTGodg). Modules 2, 3, 6: Bookings (tbl72omPibBkn2hZL). (2) Rebind Gmail OAuth on module 7 to hello@shesaidsail.com. (3) Replace PASTE_STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY_HERE in modules 4 AND 5. === STRIPE TEST MODE REQUIRED === Use your Stripe TEST secret key (sk_test_...) during all testing. Switch to live key (sk_live_...) only after full sandbox validation. Verify key starts with sk_test_ before first run. (4) Replace PASTE_QUO_SMS_API_KEY_HERE in module 8. (5) Replace PASTE_OPS_LOGGER_ALERTER_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE in module 9. IDEMPOTENCY: Module 2 SearchRecords looks for BOOKING-{request_id}-{YYYYMMDD} in Bookings Idempotency_Key field. If found, scenario exits at module 3 filter — no duplicate booking created. STRIPE FLOW: Module 4 POST /v1/prices creates one-time price (50% of Base Price in cents). Module 5 POST /v1/payment_links creates checkout link using price ID from module 4 (4.data.id). Idempotency-Key header on module 5 prevents duplicate payment links on retry. Module 6 writes Stripe_Payment_Link_URL (5.data.url), Stripe_Payment_Link_ID (5.data.id), Stripe_Price_ID (4.data.id) to Bookings. SAFETY: Module 7 filter blocks email if Automations_Paused = true. TRIGGER: Requests table, Status = AVAILABILITY_CONFIRMED, Environment = Production. Polls every 15 minutes (configure schedule in Make).
